+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4NY251FHKTW3HFKQ5J5A6HJ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8d80
+title: 'Marketplace cache telemetry: writer-lock wait, install time, snapshot reuse and removal, snapshot write size'
+---
+## What
+
+The marketplace cache writes snapshots, swaps the `current` link, removes old snapshots and takes a writer lock, but it records no telemetry. Two writers that conflict, a slow install or a large snapshot show nothing. This task uses the `Marketplace` telemetry API and the vocabulary file `Sources/Marketplace/MarketplaceTelemetry.swift` of task `5j5a6hj`.
+
+Files and points:
+- `Sources/Marketplace/MarketplaceCache.swift`:
+  - `install(snapshotAt:sha:ref:)` (`:451`).
+  - `removeUnusedSnapshots(keeping:)` (`:655`).
+  - `withWriterLock(_:)` (`:697`) and `withWriterLock(isolation:_:)` (`:725`). The lock never waits (`MarketplaceCacheError.writerLockHeld`, `:23-27`; `LOCK_NB` in `openWriterLock()`, `:735-764`): a folder that another writer holds gives `writerLockHeld` at once.
+  - `leaseCurrentSnapshot()` (`:794`).
+- `Sources/Marketplace/SnapshotWriter.swift`: `write(catalog:from:to:layout:limits:)` (`:116`).
+- `Sources/Marketplace/MarketplaceStore.swift`: the store serves a marketplace from the current snapshot of the cache or from the read-only seed folder (`:1242-1247`).
+
+Approach (each name in `MarketplaceTelemetry.swift`, metric objects made at call time):
+- Counter of writer-lock conflicts: one count each time `openWriterLock()` throws `writerLockHeld`. The lock never waits, thus record a count, not a wait time.
+- Timer of the install duration (`install(snapshotAt:sha:ref:)`), with the outcome.
+- Counter of removed snapshots: one count for each snapshot that `removeUnusedSnapshots(keeping:)` deletes.
+- Counter of snapshot reuse against a new install, with a fixed `snapshot.source` dimension: `seed`, `current` or `installed`.
+- Span for the snapshot write in `SnapshotWriter.write`, with the file count and the byte count.
+- Attribute `marketplace.id` (the display id) where it is known. Never record a path (also not the `path` of `writerLockHeld` or `cannotLock`), a URL or a credential.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each `writerLockHeld` adds one count to the writer-lock conflict counter.
+- [ ] Each install records one duration with its outcome, and each removed snapshot adds one count.
+- [ ] Each served marketplace adds one count with `snapshot.source` = `seed`, `current` or `installed`.
+- [ ] Each snapshot write opens one span with the file count and the byte count, and no span, log record or metric carries a path.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/MarketplaceTests/MarketplaceCacheTests.swift`: with `MetricsTestKit` `TestMetrics`, test the conflict count with a held writer lock, the install timer, and the removed-snapshot count.
+- [ ] `Tests/MarketplaceTests/SnapshotWriterTests.swift`: with `W3CInMemoryTracer`, test the write span and its file count and byte count.
+- [ ] `Tests/MarketplaceTests/MarketplaceStoreTests.swift`: test the reuse counter for a seed, a current snapshot and a new install, plus a content-safety test with `TelemetryCapture.run(forbidding:)` that forbids the cache path and the lock file path.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#telemetry #feature
\ No newline at end of file
